body_markdown:
## **Introduction**


Receiving USD is only one part of managing your business finances. You also need a convenient way to pay suppliers, contractors, employees and service providers. That’s where USD business payouts come in. With[Cleva’s Business Accounts](https://getcleva.com/business) , you can now send money directly from your USD balance through ACH, Wire or stablecoin transfers. So, instead of moving your money to another platform or converting it to Naira before making payments, you can manage more of your business transactions from one account.


## **What are USD Business Payouts?**


USD business payouts are payments businesses make from their USD balances to other people or businesses directly in USD. These payments can cover supplier invoices, contractor fees, employee payments, service subscriptions and other business expenses.


For businesses that receive international payments, having a USD balance is useful. However, being able to use that balance to pay people in USD is just as important.


For example, imagine your business receives payments in USD but needs to pay a supplier with a US bank account or a contractor who prefers stablecoins. Without the right payment options, you may have to move your funds between platforms before completing the transaction. Fortunately, having access to different USD payout methods makes this process more flexible.


## **How to send USD to Suppliers, Contractors and Teams with Cleva**


With Cleva’s Business Accounts, you can now send USD directly from your Cleva USD balance. You can choose between USD transfers and stablecoin transfers, depending on your recipient’s payment preference.


### **Here are the available options:**


#### **1. ACH Transfers**


ACH (Automated Clearing House) transfers let you send USD to US bank accounts. This option is useful for paying suppliers, vendors and other business partners who receive payments through US bank accounts.


For businesses that regularly work with US-based suppliers, ACH provides another way to manage payments directly from their Cleva USD balance.


#### **2. Wire Transfers**


Wire transfers give businesses another option for sending USD to US bank accounts.


Whether you’re paying a supplier, settling a business invoice or making other payments, you can choose Wire as your preferred transfer method on Cleva.


#### **3. Stablecoin Transfers**


Not every business partner prefers receiving traditional bank transfers. Some contractors, service providers and international partners may prefer stablecoins instead.


With Cleva, you can send stablecoins, including USDT and USDC, to recipients across borders or those who prefer receiving payments in stablecoins.


This gives your business more flexibility when working with people in different locations and paying them through their preferred payment method.


## **Why your business needs flexible USD payout options**


Being able to receive USD is important. However, being able to move and use those funds without unnecessary steps makes managing business finances even easier.


Here are some reasons to have flexible USD business payout options.


### **1. Pay suppliers and contractors without unnecessary currency conversions**


When you receive USD but need to make payments in USD, converting your balance into Naira just to move the money elsewhere can create unnecessary steps. With Cleva, you can send USD directly through ACH or Wire. You can also use stablecoins when your recipient prefers them.


As a result, you can keep your payments in USD without losing money to exchange rate conversions during the payout process.


### **2. Manage your business USD from one account**


Using different platforms to receive, hold and send money can make financial management more complicated. However, with Cleva’s Business Accounts, you can manage these activities from one account.


You can receive USD, hold your balance, spend with your Cleva Card and now transfer money to suppliers, contractors, employees and other recipients. This gives you more control over how your business uses its USD.


### **3. Pay people using their preferred payment method**


Your suppliers, contractors and business partners may not all use the same payment method.


For instance, a US-based supplier may prefer an ACH transfer, while another business partner may prefer stablecoins.


Instead of limiting your payment options, Cleva lets you choose between ACH, Wire and stablecoin transfers based on what works for your recipient. Consequently, you can accommodate different payment preferences without having to manage multiple accounts for different payout methods.


## **How to make USD Business Payouts on Cleva**


Sending money from your Cleva Business account is straightforward.


Follow these steps to make your first transfer:


1. Log in to your Cleva Business account.
2. Click **Transfer** on your homepage.
3. Select **+ New transfer** .
4. Choose your preferred currency transfer type.
5. Enter the recipient’s account details.
6. Complete your transfer.


That’s it! You can now send money directly from your Cleva USD balance.


## **Frequently Asked Questions about USD Business Payouts**


**1. Can I send USD from my Cleva Business account?**


Yes. Cleva’s Business customers can now transfer USD directly from their Cleva USD balance. You can choose between ACH, Wire and stablecoin transfers.


**2. What is the difference between ACH, Wire and stablecoin transfers?**


ACH and Wire are methods of transferring USD to US bank accounts. Stablecoin transfers allow you to send digital currencies such as USDT and USDC. The best option depends on your recipient’s payment preference and the type of transfer you want to make..


**3. Can I receive and send USD using the same Cleva Business account?**


Yes. Cleva’s Business Accounts allow you to receive, hold, spend and transfer USD from one account. You no longer need to move your USD to another platform just to access these payout options.


## **Conclusion**


With Cleva’s Business Accounts, you can receive, hold, spend and transfer USD, all from one account.


Whether you’re paying suppliers via ACH or Wire or sending stablecoins to international partners, you have more flexibility in how you manage your business payments.


Ready to make your USD work for your business?[Open a Cleva Business account today.](https://www.app.getcleva.com/auth/register)
